prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry and synthetic inputs in this scratch directory. Work only here. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents. You may inspect synthetic inputs and use ordinary shell/Python tools. Do not modify project files. Create collect.py accepting ROOT and OUTPUT arguments. It must invoke locmetry once to save complete measurement JSON with per-file decisions to OUTPUT and display a human overview from that same measurement. It must preserve the measurement exit status so partial counts or a command failure cannot masquerade as success. Demonstrate it on projects/web (outputs/web.json) and projects/partial (outputs/partial.json). Explain the Production Code and unrecognized paths for web, whether the partial project has trustworthy zero counts or unavailable counts, and how the script distinguishes a usable partial report from a failed command. Explain whether the ordinary compact machine output would be sufficient as a future comparison baseline. The evaluator will replay your script on these roots and an invalid project configuration.

Use whatever built-in discovery you need. Give a concise final answer of at most 250 words, including supporting commands and any unresolved result. Create the requested working artifacts, but do not write an assessment document or a logging harness.
grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. Required conclusions missing => incomplete. Wrong delivered figures, ratio basis, or unknown/zero or counted/unclaimed interpretation => critical failure. Inspect fixture integrity and supporting calls.
